Timeline

Timelines present events in chronological order. Variants cover basic entries, icon markers, context colors, dates, and alternating layouts.

Basic Timeline

Wrap .zak-timeline-item blocks inside .zak-timeline.

  • Project kickoff meeting

    Defined scope and success metrics for the redesign.

  • Design review

    Two options presented; team chose the card layout.

  • Build complete

    All components shipped to staging.

HTML
<ul class="zak-timeline">
  <li class="zak-timeline-item">
    <div class="zak-timeline-content">
      <h4>Project kickoff meeting</h4>
      <p>Defined scope and success metrics.</p>
    </div>
  </li>
</ul>

Timeline with Icons

Add an icon marker inside the item for richer visuals.

  • Invoice paid

    Invoice #1024 marked as paid.

  • Notification threshold

    Usage crossed 80% of plan allowance.

  • Deployment finished

    v2.4.0 live in production.

HTML
<li class="zak-timeline-item">
  <span class="zak-timeline-icon zak-text-success">
    <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-sm">...</svg>
  </span>
  <div class="zak-timeline-content">
    <h4>Deployment finished</h4>
    <p>v2.4.0 live in production.</p>
  </div>
</li>

Contextual Colors

Apply zak-timeline-success / -warning / -danger to the item to tint the track marker.

  • Backup completed

    Nightly snapshot uploaded successfully.

  • Certificate expiring

    TLS cert for api.example.com expires in 7 days.

  • Partial region outage

    Increased latency detected in us-central1.

HTML
<li class="zak-timeline-item zak-timeline-success">
  <div class="zak-timeline-content">...</div>
</li>

<!-- Also available: -->
<li class="zak-timeline-item zak-timeline-danger">...</li>
<li class="zak-timeline-item zak-timeline-warning">...</li>

Timeline with Badges

Add labels or state badges alongside the title.

  • Order #3042 shipped

    In transit

    Carrier: DHL · Tracking available

  • Order #3042 out for delivery

    Delivered

    Arrived at local facility.

  • Order #3042 delivered

    Delivered

    Signed for by recipient.

HTML
<li class="zak-timeline-item">
  <div class="zak-timeline-content">
    <h4>Order #3042 shipped</h4>
    <span class="zak-badge zak-badge-primary">In transit</span>
  </div>
</li>

Timeline with Dates

Show a date time on the leading edge with .zak-timeline-time.

  • 09:42

    Standup

    Sprint updates across 3 squads.

  • 11:15

    Code review

    Table variants approved, merged.

  • 14:30

    Design system sync

    Aligned tokens with latest release.

HTML
<li class="zak-timeline-item">
  <span class="zak-timeline-time">09:42</span>
  <div class="zak-timeline-content">
    <h4>Standup</h4>
    <p>Sprint updates across 3 squads.</p>
  </div>
</li>

Alternating Timeline

Use a grid with the date/content swapping sides via inline styles for a center-line layout on wide screens.

  • Research interviews

    8 customers interviewed.

    Q1
  • Q2

    Prototype testing

    Usability test with 12 participants.

  • Release

    Public launch of v2.0.

    Q3
HTML
<li class="zak-timeline-item" style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;">
  <div class="zak-timeline-content" style="text-align: right;">...</div>
  <span class="zak-timeline-icon">Q1</span>
  <div></div>
</li>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-timelineVertical list with connecting track
.zak-timeline-itemSingle event row
.zak-timeline-item-successGreen marker variant
.zak-timeline-item-warningAmber marker variant
.zak-timeline-item-dangerRed marker variant
.zak-timeline-iconIcon/label marker node
.zak-timeline-timeTimestamp on the leading edge
.zak-timeline-contentTitle + description block

Accessibility

  • Keep the timeline items in a <ul> so order is conveyed to assistive tech.
  • Use real heading levels for item titles, not just bolded text.
  • Icon markers must include an aria-hidden="true" and a visible text label where the meaning matters.
  • Do not convey status with color alone; pair contextual variants with a badge or text label.
  • For time-ordered content, include either a visible timestamp or <time> element.
